thread:
Alex G: Heads-up: customer pilot (FinData) wants single-pane console view combining per-route cost breakdown, traces for error spikes, and a simple dashboard for inference latencies. need scope decision by EOD. :eyes:
Mira P: ok — what's nonnegotiable from their ask?
Keisha L: FinData: must have per-route cost, per-model token breakdown, and trace links from error spikes to calls. they said 'must be able to correlate cost regressions to a failing prompt set.'
Samir R: tech constraints: traces are instrumented but we don't have per-token cost attribution yet. we can approximate cost by route + model + token-estimate.
Ben T: proposal: split into three slices — 1) Dashboards: per-route latency + error rate + token-estimated cost, 2) Tracing hooks: link from error spike to trace + sampling, 3) Cost drilldown: per-model token histogram + export CSV for billing.
Mira P: agree. Launch criteria? minimal: dashboards visible, trace link openable, CSV export works for last 7 days.
Alex G: ok — what about SLOs and retention? customers want 30d retention for cost metrics, 90d for traces?
Samir R: infra note: 30d metrics is fine on current retention. 90d traces is expensive — recommend 14d with on-demand rehydrate for enterprise.
Keisha L: FinData insists on 30d traces. Can we give them a private deployment exception?
Ben T: we can offer a Private deployment with 30d trace retention behind an add-on. For hosted, default 14d.
Mira P: prioritize telemetry for sample rate during high error windows — auto-increase sampling to 100% for 5m after error spike. will reduce blind spots.
Samir R: implementation: add trace hook in dataplane to flip sampling on error-window. need API: `POST /v1/observability/sampling` with body `{ "route": "...", "duration_s": 300 }`.
Alex G: action items: Samir — draft API + infra cost estimate by EOD. Mira — mockup dashboard tiles and an example CSV export. Keisha — align FinData on tradeoffs and offer private retention option. Ben — pricing note for 30d traces.
launch-bot: deploy scheduled: staging deploy at 2026-03-24T02:00Z -> observability/feature-branch
Keisha L: also capture success criteria: FinData tests must be able to (1) find trace from error spike within 2 clicks, (2) run cost export < 30s for 7d window, (3) latency dashboard shows p50/p95.
Mira P: agreed. We'll mark those as launch gates.
Ben T: risk log: CSV export large windows may time out; we need async job + email link.
Samir R: noted. I'll propose async export with pre-signed S3 link.
Alex G: timeline: slice1 dashboards + traces sampling in 2 sprints; slice2 cost drilldown + export in 1 sprint after. Communicate to FinData.
Keisha L: I'll send a short note to customer with the plan and the private retention offer.
Mira P: any other asks?
Ben T: add instrumentation for cost delta alerts (weekly) — not blocking launch, backlog item.
Alex G: cool. I'll update the roadmap doc and create tickets. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
